camel_example: aliyun sls GET /dataagents --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken MjAyNi0wOC0xNFQxMDowMDowM1oAbXktYWdlbnQ --maxResults 100 --keyword '订单' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the DataAgents within the current account. Supports fuzzy filtering by keyword and returns paginated results sorted by creation time in descending order
description_zh: 查询当前账号下的 DataAgent 列表，支持按关键字模糊过滤，并按创建时间从新到旧分页返回
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-data-agents --keyword '订单' --next-token MjAyNi0wOC0xNFQxMDowMDowM1oAbXktYWdlbnQ --max-results 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataAgents

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for fuzzy filtering. Substring matching is used and it is case-insensitive. It matches the name, display name, or description. The maximum length is 256 characters, calculated by character count rather than byte count. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 模糊过滤的搜索词（子串匹配，大小写不敏感），同时匹配名称、显示名与描述三者中的任意一项，最长 256 个字符（按字符数计算，非字节数）。不传则不过滤
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response as is. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. This value is an opaque string and its format is an implementation detail. Do not parse or construct it
parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标，取上一次响应返回的 nextToken 原样回传；首页不传。该值为不透明字符串，格式属实现细节，请勿解析或构造
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in the current request. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the specified value exceeds the valid range, the server truncates it to the boundary value
parameters.help_zh: 本次返回的最大条数，取值范围 1~100。超出范围时服务端截断到边界值
parameters.name: max_results

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns a list of DataAgents that meet the specified conditions
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回符合条件的 DataAgent 列表

items.description_en: The list of DataAgents, sorted by creation time in descending order. An empty array is returned if no matching results are found
items.description_zh: DataAgent 列表，按创建时间从新到旧排列。没有匹配结果时返回空数组

items.description_en: The configuration information of a single DataAgent
items.description_zh: 单个 DataAgent 的配置信息

contextModels.description_en: The list of context model names associated with the DataAgent
contextModels.description_zh: 该 DataAgent 关联的上下文模型名称列表

items.description_en: The name of a single context model
items.description_zh: 单个上下文模型的名称

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format in the UTC time zone, accurate to seconds
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC 时区的 ISO8601 格式，精确到秒

description.description_en: The description of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if it is not set
description.description_zh: DataAgent 的描述。未设置时返回空串
description.example: 负责分析订单与收入相关日志，并按日输出汇总报表

displayName.description_en: The display name. An empty string `""` is returned if it is not set, and it is not backfilled with the `name` value. When displaying the name, use `displayName || name` as a fallback
displayName.description_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退
displayName.title_zh: 显示名。未设置时返回空串 `""`（不会回填成 `name`），展示时请按 `displayName || name` 回退。

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role assumed by the DataAgent
roleArn.description_zh: DataAgent 扮演的 RAM 角色 ARN

systemPrompt.description_en: The system prompt of the DataAgent. An empty string is returned if it is not set
systemPrompt.description_zh: DataAgent 的系统提示词。未设置时返回空串
systemPrompt.example: 你是订单域的数据分析助手，只回答与订单、收入相关的问题，不确定时说明原因而不是猜测

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last update. The format is the same as createdAt
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次更新的时间，格式同 createdAt

nextToken.description_en: The pagination cursor for the next page. This field is not returned when the last page is reached, and no further requests are required
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的翻页游标。已到最后一页时不返回该字段，此时无需继续请求
